# simpleaudit I

Documentation for simpleaudit

> https://github.com/kelkalot/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local AI safety audit in under 5 minutes using the CLI.
- [Installation](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit via PyPI or from source, including Python 3.11+ requirements.
- [Architecture](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): High-level overview of the modular design: scenarios, judges, and the audit engine.
- [Key Ideas](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Core concepts: adversarial probing, local-first execution, and multilingual support.
